problem.title: The three gaps that hit almost every naturopath
problem.subtitle: Self-employed without a chamber-based retirement scheme means no default safety net. Three typical consequences follow.

cards.title: No safety net when you cannot work
cards.text: A slipped disc. Three months out of practice. No income. The rent still needs to be paid, and so does the practice.

cards.title: No structured retirement planning
cards.text: No statutory pension. No Rürup. At 67 the realization: the practice is your only retirement income.

cards.title: Fragmented practice insurance
cards.text: Five separate contracts from five decades. Nobody knows exactly what is covered. The premiums run every month anyway.

solution.title: Your healthcare professional bundle, all in one hand
solution.subtitle: Two pillars, eight building blocks. You choose what you need. Healio bundles, negotiates, looks after it.

pillars.title: Practice coverage
pillars.description: The healthcare bundled policy for your practice

blocks.title: Professional liability
blocks.text: <highlight>Up to 10 million euros coverage</highlight>. All therapy procedures included, even invasive ones like acupuncture, injections, detoxification.

blocks.title: Practice interruption
blocks.text: 3 days waiting period, 24 months coverage. Also for infection and official closure.

blocks.title: Cyber protection
blocks.text: GDPR-compliant protection against data breaches, ransomware and the 72-hour reporting requirement.

blocks.title: Legal expenses
blocks.text: German health advertising law, employment, contract law, tax disputes.

blocks.title: Disability insurance
blocks.text: Volkswohl Bund Existenz. Terms rated very good to excellent. <highlight>Up to 30 percent cheaper</highlight> in a group contract.

blocks.title: Rürup base pension
blocks.text: Fund-linked, fully deductible as special expenses. Example: 15,000 euro annual contribution at 42 percent marginal tax rate yields <highlight>about 6,300 euro tax savings per year</highlight>. 2026 limits: 30,826 euro (single), 61,652 euro (married).

blocks.title: Basic skills insurance
blocks.text: As a backup if disability insurance is only available with surcharges or exclusions.

blocks.title: Term life and care
blocks.text: For family, partner and practice loans. Private long-term care as an optional add-on.
